pages.title: Foliot Transporter
pages.text: The transporter is useful in that you don't need a train of hoppers$(br)transporting stuff, and can use any inventory to take from and deposit.$(br2)To make it take from an inventory simply sneak and interact$(br)with it's book $()

pages.title: Foliot Transporter
pages.text: of calling on the inventory you want.$(br)

You can also dictate which inventory it deposits to in the same way.$(br2)The transporter will move all items it can access from one inventory to another,$(br) including machines. It can also deposit into the inventories of other $()
spirits.$(br) By setting the extract and insert side they can be used to automate various transport tasks.$(br)

pages.title: Spirit Inventories
pages.text: The Transporter can also interact with the inventories of other spirits.$(br)This is especially useful to automatically supply a $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_crusher_t1)Crusher spirit$(/l) with items to crush,$(br)a $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_smelter_t1)Smelter spirit$(/l) with items to smelt or a $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_crystallizer_t1)Crystallizer spirit$(/l) with $()

pages.title: Item Filters
pages.text: Shift-click the transporter to open the config UI.$(br)The filter slot accepts a $(item)list filter$() or $(item)attribute filter$(), which control what the transporter extracts or inserts.$(br)A transporter without a filter will move any items it can reach. See $()

pages.title: Item Filters
pages.text: Spirit Filters for details and recipes.$(br)

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Use the book of calling to set the extract and insert location of the transporter.$(br2) $(br) See Books of Calling for more information.$(br)
